turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm here. It's 4:15 and I have a client call at 4:40, so I'd like to know why my son found out about a zero from his phone.
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
You're asking me how to do your job, Hale? I'm here as Owen's mother, and as his mother I want the zero withdrawn. Then tell me why nobody called me before it went into the gradebook.
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
That's between you and your family, Hale. We're here about Owen. Is the zero coming off or not?
